entities.summary: Tom Loftin Johnson was an American industrialist, Georgist politician, and important figure of the Progressive Era and a pioneer in urban political and social reform. He was a U.S. representative from 1891 to 1895 and mayor of Cleveland for four terms from 1901 to 1909.
